queries_run: DISCO Corporation regulatory scrutiny export controls semiconductor equipment Japan 2026
6146.T DISCO DOJ OR FTC OR EU competition 2026

findings.claim: DISCO 於 2026-08-04 公告：已向經產省查詢，確認社群傳聞的新出口管制並未公布或實施
findings.source: DISCO 公司公告 Regarding Inaccurate Information Concerning DISCO (Second Notice)
findings.excerpt: claiming that the Japanese government implemented new export controls on semiconductor manufacturing equipment effective August 1, 2026, and that DISCO products are subject to such controls. DISCO has made inquiries with the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry and has confirmed that no such controls have been promulgated or implemented.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 未查到針對 DISCO 的反壟斷調查、拆分或 DOJ/FTC/EU 競爭案。GCR 'Disco acquisition halted by the courts' 無內文，無法確認是否同一公司。僅有公司自己 2026-08 澄清社群傳言（日本新出口管制 8/1 生效）的公告，未核原文。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
